title: DevEx-MCP
description: A Model Context Protocol server I built at Rappi that connects AI agents (Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to the company's microservices documentation. Agents can search the microservices catalog, compare READMEs and pull exact OpenAPI specs on their own, through a local stdio bridge with token auth, auto-update and a one-command installer.

title: Skynet: n8n Homelab Assistant
description: A personal AI assistant on Telegram that understands text and voice notes, chats about anything and manages a to-do list through tool calling. Built as n8n workflows (AI Agent + Postgres memory, Groq LLM and Whisper) running 24/7 on a recycled PC with Docker, exposed only via Tailscale Funnel, with automated backups, self-healing network and Telegram alerts. Zero cost.

title: Improvisador
description: A public speaking practice web app: spin the deck, get a random topic and talk about it, either improvised or after a deep-research round. A side project built for my social media audience, live at improvisador.lat with 1,000+ monthly users.
